request.html:
data [required]

object

Data envelope for creating an OpenAI Model Inference integration account.

attributes [required]

object

Writable attributes used to create an OpenAI Model Inference integration account.

authentication [required]

 <oneOf>

Authentication for creating the OpenAI Model Inference integration account. Set exactly one method.

<auth_type=bearer_token>

object

Bearer token authentication. Use a project-scoped OpenAI API key with Write permission for model capabilities. While openai-llm-completions is enabled, the API returns a 422 response for a key that cannot call the OpenAI chat completions endpoint.

auth_type [required]

enum

The authentication method type. Allowed enum values: bearer_token

default: bearer_token

token [required]

string

Secret token used to authenticate with OpenAI.

dataflows

object

Data Datadog collects from OpenAI Model Inference, keyed by dataflow ID. Each dataflow turns on a distinct type of collection. Set enabled to start or stop a dataflow. The default for each dataflow applies when the account is created. On update, omitted fields keep their current values.

openai-llm-completions

object

Makes the key in authentication available to run evaluations in LLM Observability. While this dataflow is enabled, the API returns a 422 response for a key that cannot call the OpenAI chat completions endpoint.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to true. Set to false to stop collection.

openai-project-cloud-cost-data

object

Costs of the OpenAI project that owns the key in authentication. Analyze these costs in Cloud Cost Management. Cost data appears in Cloud Cost Management within 24 hours after you enable this dataflow.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to false. Set to true to start collection.

name [required]

string

Human-readable name of the OpenAI Model Inference integration account.

settings [required]

object

Settings for creating the OpenAI Model Inference integration account.

custom_tags

string

Comma-separated list of custom tags applied to the data collected for this account, for example team:ai,env:prod.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account

request.html:
data [required]

object

Data envelope for updating an OpenAI Model Inference integration account.

attributes [required]

object

Writable attributes used to update an OpenAI Model Inference integration account. Every field is optional. Only the provided fields are changed. When dataflows is provided, only the dataflow IDs in the request are modified. Dataflows omitted from the map keep their current configuration.

authentication

 <oneOf>

Authentication for updating the OpenAI Model Inference integration account. Set exactly one method.

<auth_type=bearer_token>

object

Bearer token authentication. Use a project-scoped OpenAI API key with Write permission for model capabilities. While openai-llm-completions is enabled, the API returns a 422 response for a key that cannot call the OpenAI chat completions endpoint. Only the provided fields are changed. To keep the stored token, omit token.

auth_type [required]

enum

The authentication method type. Allowed enum values: bearer_token

default: bearer_token

token

string

Secret token used to authenticate with OpenAI.

dataflows

object

Data Datadog collects from OpenAI Model Inference, keyed by dataflow ID. Each dataflow turns on a distinct type of collection. Set enabled to start or stop a dataflow. The default for each dataflow applies when the account is created. On update, omitted fields keep their current values.

openai-llm-completions

object

Makes the key in authentication available to run evaluations in LLM Observability. While this dataflow is enabled, the API returns a 422 response for a key that cannot call the OpenAI chat completions endpoint.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to true. Set to false to stop collection.

openai-project-cloud-cost-data

object

Costs of the OpenAI project that owns the key in authentication. Analyze these costs in Cloud Cost Management. Cost data appears in Cloud Cost Management within 24 hours after you enable this dataflow.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to false. Set to true to start collection.

name

string

Human-readable name of the OpenAI Model Inference integration account.

settings

object

Settings for updating the OpenAI Model Inference integration account. Only the fields provided are changed.

custom_tags

string

Comma-separated list of custom tags applied to the data collected for this account, for example team:ai,env:prod.

id [required]

string

Unique identifier of the OpenAI Model Inference integration account to update.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account
